description:
Dorion is an alternative Discord client aimed towards lower-spec or storage-sensitive PCs that supports themes, plugins, and more!


# Changes

• Fix crash when opening links (#508)
• Fix links not opening in browser
• Fix flashbang on startup (#507)
• Properly persist zoom level when using the hotkeys (#510)
• Disable the WebView's <kbd>Shift</kbd> + <kbd>Esc</kbd> keybind, allowing the Discord bind to take precedence (#512)
